scope: P01 theory, exact counterexamples and constructed development; no native simulator execution.

predecessor.preservation: Original files retained; this is a new version.

card.title: Short observable response histories predict terminal reconstruction under a fixed apparatus
card.claim: The declared native response process may admit the fixed two-mode law and its structured HMM realization, enabling calibrated, economical terminal forecasts from depths 0,1,2.
assumptions: Fixed declared renewal, damage, resource and assay contract; persistent state and randomness correctly accounted for.
Independent stationary binary identity and readability modes with independent initial factors for the joint HMM realization.
Deterministic A/B/neither emissions conditional on the model's four hidden states; this is an additional native assumption, not guaranteed by the marginal law.
No unmodelled delayed failure, changing rates, identity-readability coupling or informative external identity refresh.
Short observations have the declared independent-path and block structure; no hidden-state labels supplied.
Sampling uncertainty, boundary fits, missing categories and structural error are assessed; optimizer success is not identification.

boundary.native_candidate: E041 full-rewrite packet weights; fresh bodies reset
boundary.external: Reader/writer code, ports, dynamics, cues, noise/damage distributions and resources remain supplied
boundary.complete_state_status: Code-informed candidate boundary; native statistical sufficiency not established

endpoint.primary: Three-category terminal assay A/B/neither at a single horizon to be justified and frozen
endpoint.rule_definition: Two opposed prescribed conditional functions; native both-cue strict output margins >0.25 over final 32 dynamics steps
endpoint.present_vs_future: Current expression is not terminal reconstruction
endpoint.historical_specificity: Fit own and foreign records separately under the same A assay; subtract their A probabilities
endpoint.all_cycle: Outside this terminal marginal claim; requires the joint cycle-success/successor kernel

card.inference_unit: Independent founder/history block; short paths and long descendants nested within block; exact design pending
development_data: User-supplied E051 interim aggregates recorded in registers.json
card.proposed_holdout: Previously uninspected founder/history blocks with all short observations and forecasts frozen before later continuation outcomes; access audit and exact packet list pending. Remaining E051 blocks are not designated an untouched RDT holdout.
controls: Protected-copy reference under explicit resource/loss contract

baselines.name: Ordinary output Markov
baselines.role: Equal short observations; unsupported rows explicit

baselines.name: Same structured conventional HMM
baselines.role: Exact mathematical tie; not a superiority target

baselines.name: Strong initial-packet plus probe predictor
baselines.role: Development-tuned with matched information and tuning access

baselines.name: Native basin/sensitivity predictor where applicable
baselines.role: Declare extra observations and cost; full-dynamics oracle separate

card.direction: For chi0>0, larger lambda preserves A bias longer; readability can rise or fall toward pi depending on r0. No direction is asserted for arbitrary mechanism changes such as fallback deactivation.

uncertainty.current: Toy point forecasts only; no native confidence claim
uncertainty.required: Calibrate founder/block resampling or simulation-based method; propagate rare-loss and boundary uncertainty, retain unsupported/abstention rates; assess model misspecification separately

candidate_scoring.primary: Categorical Brier score with block weighting
candidate_scoring.multiple_comparisons: Select a primary rival using frozen development rule or correct the family; no treating horizons as independent replicates

numerical_native_requirements.reason: Must be justified by native feasibility, variance and cost evidence before confirmation; toy numbers are illustrative only.

failure_conditions: Marginal depth restrictions or joint observation model systematically fail.
Frozen long-horizon distributions are inaccurate or uncertainty intervals miscalibrated.
Rare losses are unresolved at the permitted short-probe budget.
Simpler or cost-equivalent conventional models suffice.
Forecast only succeeds with future information, hidden oracle states, or outcome-informed changes.

outcome_interpretations.accurate_calibrated_economical: Support only the declared empirical reduction and domain; no claim of novel HMM mathematics.
outcome_interpretations.tied_simpler: No demonstrated added predictive value for RDT.
outcome_interpretations.inaccurate: Reject or narrow this version; preserve failure and version any revision.
outcome_interpretations.unidentifiable: No informative forecast at that budget; retain abstention as a cost.
outcome_interpretations.invalid_apparatus: Measurement failure, not a theory verdict; fix before inference.
outcome_interpretations.mechanism_changes_without_performance_lo: Mechanistic change alone does not imply fragility.
